artifacts.summary: Design research for the /books --review and --revise commands: mirrors /distill's three-layer command/skill/pattern-file split verbatim, grounds the books-domain vocabulary (seven dimensions, Validated-by marker three-form vocabulary, observation-record schema, digest log), confirms AskUserQuestion must stay in the lead-session direct-execution skill, and proposes a description-convention shape for research-and-escalate tasks since none exists in this codebase.

memory_candidates.content: AskUserQuestion is unreachable from a dispatched subagent on this harness. Every proven interactive multi-candidate flow in this codebase (skill-distill's --meta/--revise/--learn, skill-fix-it) keeps the AskUserQuestion gate inline in a direct-execution skill body (no Agent-tool dispatch around the gate itself), delegating only non-interactive work (e.g. task creation primitives) to a subagent. skill-fix-it's own docs state this explicitly: 'No subagent delegation. Everything executes directly in skill-fix-it using AskUserQuestion for interactivity.'

The /distill command's Shared Sub-Mode Skeleton in skill-distill/SKILL.md (measured lines 278-321) is a reusable seven-step shape for any new maintenance-style sub-mode family: Edge Case Checks, Candidate Identification, Dry-Run, Interactive Selection (MANDATORY STOP, with report/review/auto as the only sanctioned skip), Execution, Batch Index Regeneration, Log Entry. Each sub-mode's actual logic lives in its own extracted pattern file reached via a one-line 'READ {path} now and follow it exactly' stub, keeping the skill file itself thin regardless of how many sub-modes it grows to.

A maintenance-only command family outside the task research/plan/implement lifecycle (e.g. /distill, /learn, and by extension /books --review/--revise) should carry NO routing_agents entry in its extension's manifest.json -- routing_agents is reserved for actual task_type dispatch. The memory extension's manifest.json confirms this: distill.md/skill-distill and learn.md/skill-learn appear only in provides.commands/provides.skills, with routing_agents carrying just a single 'memory' task_type row unrelated to either command.
